g.text: Qualitative, formula-generated sketches with arbitrary plotting coordinates. They are hypotheses to test, not paper results.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b4a68

g.text: Actual prefix outcomes can be nonmonotonic; actual cost comparisons can favor the baseline. No uncertainty bands or numerical promises are implied.
